svg.text: How the model file got here: seven revisions, and what each one found
Four of these defects produced no error. The code ran, the loss fell, the metrics were plausible, and something load-bearing was inert.
v3 — ARCHITECTURE COMPLETE
17 implementation phases
Band-agnostic spectral pathway,
SS2D scan registry, pluggable fusion,
config dataclass with validation.
Everything after this is repair.
v12 / v13 — THE DATA WAS LYING
SIGBUS inside loader workers
A training array unreadable from byte
file, while its header read cleanly.
Fix: manifest + SHA-256 preflight.
THE SCHEDULE WAS ON THE WRONG AXIS
Every run peaked at epoch 1
The training split resamples each epoch;
a per-epoch schedule ran out long before
the data did, then decayed monotonically.
Fix: step the schedule on optimizer steps.
v15 R1 — REPRESENTATION COLLAPSE
Four instances of one mechanism
A signal added to a much larger constant,
then normalized away. Input was 86–93×
smaller than its positional encoding; the
stem's input sat below LayerNorm's eps.
v15 R3 — CHUNKING AND CHECKPOINTING
Two knobs that were not knobs
Chunk size hardcoded at 1024; core
checkpointing unconditional but reported
as a flag it did not obey.
Also: one mixer flag was worth 39×.
v15 R4 — THE HALF-WIRED HALT HEAD
20 % of the objective, read by nothing
A BCE term trained q; no code ever
consumed it. Measured flat at 0.66 against
ln 2 = 0.693 for 33 epochs — chance.
Fix: real ACT, or none. Runs use none.
v16 — RECONSTRUCTION AND REPORTING
A gradient that never arrived
The decoder read a DETACHED feature map,
so the auxiliary loss trained the decoder
and shaped nothing. Metrics were also
computed in normalized, not reflectance, units.
CURRENT gmedmamba.py
2,212 lines, both variants, one flag
Hierarchical and recursive backbones behind
one config field, sharing the spectral front
end, the head interface and the output dict.
Every repair above is a config field whose
default reproduces the pre-fix behaviour.
What caught them
Not review — measurement of the MECHANISM rather than the outcome:
• comparing the magnitude of a signal against the constant it is added to;
• checking whether a normalization's epsilon sits above or below the
variance of its own input;
• asserting in a test that a gradient reaches a named module;
• reading what a term contributes to the objective against its own floor.
Several of these are now preflight gates that abort a run rather than
annotate it. That is the form the lesson took in this repository.
The discipline that made the audit possible
Once a file is the audited entry point for a recorded run, it is not edited.
New capability arrives by subclassing or by wrapping at runtime:
• prepare_histologyhsi_bc_v8 imports v6 and v7 — "frozen, imported not edited";
• training/spectral_checkpoint.py wraps at runtime so "gmedmamba.py stays untouched".
Where a change HAD to reach the model file, it became a config field defaulting
to the old behaviour — so an existing checkpoint still loads with strict=True.
It costs duplication: eight train_example_v*.py and nine preparation scripts.
It buys the thing this paper needs: a run from five weeks ago is still rebuildable.
